# Poe2BuffsAccessor

[API index](../index.md)

Lossless buff queries for one actor. Named lookup selects the first readable instance.

**@keywords**

buffs, owner, duplicates, player, monster

## ByName

```typescript
ByName(name: string): Poe2StatusEffect;
```

Find the first buff with this exact definition name, also available as Buffs[name].
Missing or unreadable buffs have Exists=false; Current exposes availability and duplicate rows.

**@keywords**

buffs, lookup, name, indexer, reagent

## Has

```typescript
Has(name: string): boolean;
```

Whether a freshly readable buff has this exact definition name.

**@keywords**

buffs, presence, active, name

## AllBuffs

```typescript
AllBuffs: Poe2StatusEffect[];
```

All freshly readable buff instances, preserving duplicate names in source order.

**@keywords**

buffs, enumerate, duplicates, reagent

## Current

```typescript
Current: Poe2BuffCollectionAccessor | null;
```

`None` is unavailable; `Some` with zero rows is a known-empty collection.
